DeepMind plans a new Cambridge-area robotics hardware lab

Aaron Saunders announced the facility without a budget, size or opening date.

Humanoids Daily ↗12 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

A home for the hardware team

Aaron Saunders announced on LinkedIn that Google DeepMind is building a Cambridge-area robotics lab for the hardware team developed since he joined a year earlier. Recruitment context identifies Cambridge, Massachusetts; the facility has not been announced as operational.

Recruiting builders and researchers

The post invites machinists, engineers and researchers to join. It highlights the physical facilities and hardware skills needed alongside AI research. Saunders previously served as Boston Dynamics’ chief technology officer before joining DeepMind in 2025.

Details still undisclosed

The announcement gives no building size, budget, exact address or new robot model. More news in 2027 does not establish an opening or product-launch date. The publisher’s AI-generated illustration does not show the lab’s actual location.
